description: Build the quarantine request bodies for one workload: the pod label patch, the CiliumNetworkPolicy and the YAML shown to the approver. Naming zt-quarantine-<workload>-<job id>; the label value is the job id. Same logic as ztgen/cnp.py build() in the Splunk app.

inputs.name: namespace
inputs.description: Namespace of the pod, for example build-farm

inputs.name: workload
inputs.description: Workload as namespace/name or name, for example build-farm/ci-runner

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.description: CI job id; becomes the label value

inputs.name: finding_id
inputs.description: Finding id carried in the policy label zt/finding

outputs.name: policy_yaml
outputs.description: The policy as shown to the approver
